fields.description: Plaza 2 offers compact apartments and a limited townhouse collection in Masdar City. Junior one-bedroom homes are listed separately from studios, while the four-bedroom townhouses use three levels with front or rear outdoor space.

sources.label: Property Finder · Plaza 2 secondary status and pricing

overview: The factsheet lists 120 homes, including 12 four-bedroom townhouses.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays AED 800k and older unit guides from AED 530k; Tanami advertises AED 500k. No current developer unit quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: Tanami advertises 10% booking and 1% monthly, without a complete installment count or final balance. No original developer payment calendar was retrieved; no schedule is inferred.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder marks the project ready with January 2026 delivery; Tanami retains Q4 2025. Both dates have elapsed. The developer’s undated 65% label does not verify completion or current availability.
unresolved: The brochure prints 98 total homes, while its component counts sum to 120, matching the factsheet and current webpage.
Published totals include outdoor areas and occasional component discrepancies; junior one-bedroom 489 + 50 prints 538 ft². Figures are not silently repaired.
Townhouse areas cover complete three-level homes. Confirm delivery certification, stock, fees, charges and parking allocation.
